# Mairhofer Advokatur
> Liechtenstein law firm offering personal legal counsel in Liechtenstein, Austria, and Poland. Founded by Remo Mairhofer.

## About
Mairhofer Advokatur is a boutique law firm based in Schaan, Liechtenstein. The firm takes a personal, engaged approach — every mandate starts with listening and understanding the full picture before acting with precision. The firm covers private clients, corporate law, real estate, financial market law, digital business, and dispute resolution. Partners: Remo Mairhofer (founder) and Dr. Tomasz Klimek.
